      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .btn-app:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .btn-app .btn-app-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; opacity: .6; display: block; line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 2px; }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       HEADER
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.9);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }
    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 68px;
    }
    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy-dark);
      letter-spacing: -.03em;
    }
    .logo-mark {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 10px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .logo-mark svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
    .logo-dot { color: var(--yellow); }

    .nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
    .nav-link {
      padding: 8px 14px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: color .15s, background .15s;
    }
    .nav-link:hover { color: var(--navy); background: var(--gray-50); }
    .header-cta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .btn-sm { padding: 8px 18px; font-size: 14px; }

    /* Hamburger */
    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      padding: 8px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }
    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      width: 22px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all .25s;
    }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; transform: scaleX(0); }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }

    /* Mobile drawer */
    .mobile-drawer {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 200;
    }
    .drawer-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,.45);
      animation: fadeIn .2s ease;
    }
    .drawer-panel {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      right: 0;
      width: min(320px, 88vw);
      height: 100%;
      background: white;
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      animation: slideDown .25s ease;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
    }
    .drawer-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .drawer-close {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-50);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }
    .drawer-link {
      display: block;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--navy-dark);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: background .15s;
    }
    .drawer-link:hover { background: var(--gray-50); }
    .drawer-divider { height: 1px; background: var(--gray-100); margin: 8px 0; }
    .drawer-actions { margin-top: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .drawer-btn { width: 100%; text-align: center; padding: 14px; }
    .mobile-drawer.open { display: block; }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       HERO
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 580px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-dark) 0%, var(--navy) 50%, #2d1b8f 100%);
    }
    .hero-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    /* Geometric blobs */
    .hero-blob {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(60px);
      opacity: .18;
    }
    .hero-blob-1 {
      width: 500px; height: 500px;
      background: var(--yellow);
      top: -120px; right: -80px;
    }
    .hero-blob-2 {
      width: 350px; height: 350px;
      background: #7c3aed;
      bottom: -80px; left: 10%;
    }
    .hero-blob-3 {
      width: 200px; height: 200px;
      background: var(--teal);
      top: 30%; right: 25%;
    }
    /* Dot grid */
    .hero-dots {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,.12) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 28px 28px;
    }

    .hero-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      padding: 80px 0 48px;
      text-align: center;
      width: 100%;
    }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(255,217,48,.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,217,48,.35);
      color: var(--yellow);
      border-radius: 100px;
      padding: 6px 16px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .hero-badge-dot {
      width: 6px; height: 6px;
      background: var(--yellow);
      border-radius: 50%;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero-badge-dot::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: -3px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--yellow);
      animation: pulse-ring 1.5s ease-out infinite;
    }
    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5.5vw, 62px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      letter-spacing: -.03em;
      line-height: 1.1;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .hero-title-accent {
      color: var(--yellow);
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: clamp(15px, 2vw, 18px);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.75);
      line-height: 1.65;
      max-width: 580px;
      margin: 0 auto 40px;
    }

    /* ─── Search Card ─── */
    .search-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 8px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      max-width: 860px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      gap: 0;
      align-items: stretch;
      animation: scaleIn .6s .4s ease both;
    }
    .search-field {
      flex: 1;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }
    .search-field:last-of-type { border-right: none; }
    .search-field-icon {
      position: absolute;
      left: 16px;
      color: var(--navy);
      pointer-events: none;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .search-field-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
    .search-input, .search-select {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 16px 16px 16px 44px;
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text);
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      outline: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    }
    .search-input::placeholder, .search-select option[disabled] { color: var(--text-muted); }
    .search-select { appearance: none; cursor: pointer; }
    .search-select-arrow {
      position: absolute;
      right: 14px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .search-btn {
      padding: 14px 28px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      transition: background .2s, transform .2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .search-btn:hover { background: var(--navy-light); transform: scale(1.02); }
    .search-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

    /* Autocomplete dropdown */
    .autocomplete-dropdown {
      display: none;
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 8px);
      left: -8px;
      right: -8px;
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      overflow: hidden;
      z-index: 50;
      animation: slideDown .15s ease;
    }
    .autocomplete-dropdown.open { display: block; }
    .autocomplete-section-label {
      padding: 10px 16px 6px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }
    .autocomplete-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 10px 16px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background .12s;
    }
    .autocomplete-item:hover, .autocomplete-item.selected { background: var(--gray-50); }
    .autocomplete-item-icon {
      width: 32px; height: 32px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--gray-50);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      font-size: 16px;
    }
    .autocomplete-item-sub {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-weight: 400;
    }

    /* Trust row */
    .hero-trust {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 24px;
      margin-top: 28px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .hero-trust-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.7);
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .hero-trust-item svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--yellow); }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       STATS BAR
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .stats-bar {
      background: var(--off-white);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }
    .stats-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: stretch;
      justify-content: space-around;
      padding: 32px 0;
    }
    .stat-item {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0 24px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .stat-item + .stat-item::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: 10%;
      height: 80%;
      width: 1px;
      background: var(--gray-100);
    }
    .stat-number {
      font-size: clamp(26px, 3.5vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy-dark);
      letter-spacing: -.03em;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .stat-number span { color: var(--navy); }
    .stat-label {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    .stat-icon {
      width: 36px; height: 36px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: rgba(27,20,100,.08);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 10px;
    }
    .stat-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--navy); }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       SPECIALTIES
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .specialties { background: white; }
    .specialties-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 52px;
    }
    .specialties-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .specialty-card {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 28px 16px;
      background: white;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-100);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all .2s ease;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .specialty-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(27,20,100,.04), transparent);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity .2s;
    }
    .specialty-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--navy);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }
    .specialty-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
    .specialty-icon {
      width: 60px; height: 60px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 28px;
      transition: transform .2s;
    }
    .specialty-card:hover .specialty-icon { transform: scale(1.1); }
    .specialty-name {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy-dark);
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .specialty-desc {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .specialty-arrow {
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: white;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(4px);
      transition: all .2s;
    }
    .specialty-arrow svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
    .specialty-card:hover .specialty-arrow { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

    /* Icon color themes */
    .ic-blue   { background: rgba(14,165,233,.12); }
    .ic-emerald{ background: rgba(16,185,129,.12); }
    .ic-rose   { background: rgba(244,63,94,.12); }
    .ic-violet { background: rgba(139,92,246,.12); }
    .ic-amber  { background: rgba(245,158,11,.12); }
    .ic-navy   { background: rgba(27,20,100,.08); }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       HOW IT WORKS
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .how-it-works { background: var(--off-white); }
    .hiw-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 60px;
    }
    .hiw-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      position: relative;
    }
    /* Connector line */
    .hiw-steps::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 44px;
      left: calc(50% / 3);
      right: calc(50% / 3);
      height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--navy) 0%, var(--yellow) 100%);
      border-radius: 2px;
    }
    .hiw-step {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 36px 28px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: box-shadow .2s, transform .2s;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hiw-step:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-4px); }
    .hiw-step-num {
      width: 52px; height: 52px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: white;
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hiw-step:nth-child(2) .hiw-step-num { background: var(--teal); }
    .hiw-step:nth-child(3) .hiw-step-num { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy), var(--teal)); }
    .hiw-step-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: -8px;
      right: -8px;
      background: var(--yellow);
      width: 20px; height: 20px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid white;
    }
    .hiw-step-title {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy-dark);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      letter-spacing: -.01em;
    }
    .hiw-step-desc {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.65;
    }
    .hiw-step-icon { margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 32px; }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       TESTIMONIALS
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .testimonials { background: white; }
    .testimonials-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 52px;
    }
    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .testimonial-card {
      background: var(--off-white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: box-shadow .2s, transform .2s;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .testimonial-card::before {
      content: '"';
      position: absolute;
      top: -8px;
      left: 24px;
      font-size: 120px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy);
      opacity: .05;
      line-height: 1;
      font-family: Georgia, serif;
    }
    .testimonial-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-4px); }
    .testimonial-stars {
      display: flex;
      gap: 3px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .star { color: var(--yellow); font-size: 16px; }
    .testimonial-text {
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      font-style: italic;
    }
    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .av-purple { background: rgba(139,92,246,.15); color: #7c3aed; }
    .av-blue   { background: rgba(14,165,233,.15); color: #0284c7; }
    .av-teal   { background: rgba(16,185,129,.15); color: #059669; }
    .testimonial-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; color: var(--navy-dark); }
    .testimonial-loc  { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px; }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       APP PROMO
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .app-promo {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-dark), var(--navy-light));
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }
    .app-promo-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,.06) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 24px 24px;
    }
    .app-promo-inner {
      position: relative;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 60px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .app-promo-text { }
    .app-promo-label { color: var(--yellow); border-color: rgba(255,217,48,.3); background: rgba(255,217,48,.12); margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .app-promo-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      letter-spacing: -.03em;
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .app-promo-subtitle {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.72);
      line-height: 1.65;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .app-promo-features {
      margin-bottom: 36px;
    }
    .app-feature {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 8px 0;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.85);
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .app-feature-icon {
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: rgba(255,217,48,.15);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 14px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .app-buttons { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .app-promo-visual {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: flex-end;
      position: relative;
      height: 380px;
    }
    /* Phone mockup */
    .phone-mockup {
      width: 200px;
      height: 360px;
      background: white;
      border-radius: 32px;
      box-shadow: 0 32px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
      padding: 12px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      animation: float 4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .phone-screen {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--off-white);
      border-radius: 22px;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    .phone-status { height: 28px; background: var(--navy-dark); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
    .phone-notch { width: 70px; height: 10px; background: black; border-radius: 6px; }
    .phone-content { padding: 12px 10px; flex: 1; }
    .phone-header-bar { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy-dark); margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .phone-search-bar {
      background: white;
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 8px 10px;
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .phone-mini-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .phone-mini-avatar {
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(27,20,100,.1);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    .phone-mini-info { }
    .phone-mini-name { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy-dark); }
    .phone-mini-spec { font-size: 8px; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .phone-mini-btn {
      margin-left: auto;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: white;
      font-size: 7px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }
    .phone-shadow {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -20px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 160px;
      height: 40px;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,.3);
      filter: blur(20px);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    /* Second phone offset */
    .phone-mockup-2 {
      position: absolute;
      right: 20px;
      bottom: 20px;
      width: 160px;
      height: 290px;
      opacity: .55;
      z-index: 1;
      animation: float 4s 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       FOOTER
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .footer {
      background: var(--navy-dark);
      padding: 60px 0 0;
    }
    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 40px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .footer-brand .logo { color: white; margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .footer-brand-desc {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.55);
      line-height: 1.7;
      max-width: 260px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .footer-tagline {
      display: inline-block;
      background: rgba(255,217,48,.12);
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,217,48,.25);
    }
    .footer-col-title {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.45);
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }
    .footer-links { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .footer-link {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.65);
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: color .15s;
    }
    .footer-link:hover { color: white; }
    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      padding: 20px 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .footer-copy {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.4);
    }
    .footer-copy strong { color: var(--yellow); }
    .footer-legal { display: flex; gap: 20px; }
    .footer-legal a {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.4);
      transition: color .15s;
    }
    .footer-legal a:hover { color: white; }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       SCROLL REVEAL
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(20px);
      transition: opacity .6s ease, transform .6s ease;
    }
    .reveal.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
    .reveal-delay-1 { transition-delay: .1s; }
    .reveal-delay-2 { transition-delay: .2s; }
    .reveal-delay-3 { transition-delay: .3s; }
    .reveal-delay-4 { transition-delay: .4s; }
    .reveal-delay-5 { transition-delay: .5s; }
    .reveal-delay-6 { transition-delay: .6s; }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       RESPONSIVE
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .specialties-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: span 2; }
      .hiw-steps::before { display: none; }
      .app-promo-inner { gap: 40px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .section { padding: 60px 0; }
      .nav, .header-cta { display: none; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }

      .search-card {
        flex-direction: column;
        border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
        gap: 2px;
        padding: 6px;
      }
      .search-field {
        border-right: none;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      }
      .search-field:last-of-type { border-bottom: none; }
      .search-btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; margin-top: 4px; }

      .specialties-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .hiw-steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .testimonials-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .app-promo-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .app-promo-visual { display: none; }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: span 2; }
      .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
      .stats-inner { flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; }
      .stat-item + .stat-item::before { display: none; }

      .hero-title { font-size: 32px; }
      .hero-subtitle { font-size: 15px; }
      .hero-trust { gap: 12px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .specialties-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: span 1; }
      .app-buttons { flex-direction: column; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<script>
  // ─── Hamburger / Mobile Drawer ───────────────────
  const hamburger   = document.getElementById('hamburgerBtn');
  const drawer      = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
  const overlay     = document.getElementById('drawerOverlay');
  const drawerClose = document.getElementById('drawerClose');

  function openDrawer() {
    drawer.classList.add('open');
    hamburger.classList.add('open');
    hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }
  function closeDrawer() {
    drawer.classList.remove('open');
    hamburger.classList.remove('open');
    hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
    drawer.classList.contains('open') ? closeDrawer() : openDrawer();
  });
  overlay.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  drawerClose.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeDrawer(); });

  // ─── Search Autocomplete ─────────────────────────
  const searchInput  = document.getElementById('searchInput');
  const autoDropdown = document.getElementById('autocompleteDropdown');
  const autoItems    = autoDropdown.querySelectorAll('.autocomplete-item');

  const allSuggestions = [
    { icon: '🏥', label: 'Primary Care',        sub: 'Annual checkups, sick visits' },
    { icon: '🦷', label: 'Dentist',              sub: 'Cleanings, fillings, oral health' },
    { icon: '🔬', label: 'Dermatologist',        sub: 'Skin conditions, acne, cosmetic' },
    { icon: '🧠', label: 'Psychiatrist',         sub: 'Mental health, medication management' },
    { icon: '👁️', label: 'Eye Doctor',           sub: 'Vision exams, glasses prescriptions' },
    { icon: '🦴', label: 'Orthopedic Surgeon',   sub: 'Joint pain, fractures, sports injuries' },
    { icon: '👩‍⚕️', label: 'Dr. Sarah Chen',    sub: 'Family Medicine · 4.9★' },
    { icon: '👨‍⚕️', label: 'Dr. Marcus Webb',   sub: 'Orthopedic Surgeon · 4.8★' },
    { icon: '💊', label: 'Back pain',            sub: 'Condition' },
    { icon: '💊', label: 'Anxiety',              sub: 'Condition' },
    { icon: '💊', label: 'Diabetes',             sub: 'Condition' },
  ];

  function buildDropdown(query) {
    const q = query.toLowerCase().trim();
    autoDropdown.innerHTML = '';
    const filtered = q
      ? allSuggestions.filter(s => s.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) || s.sub.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      : allSuggestions.slice(0, 5);

    if (!filtered.length) {
      autoDropdown.innerHTML = '<div class="autocomplete-item" style="color:var(--text-muted);">No results found</div>';
    } else {
      filtered.forEach(s => {
        const el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = 'autocomplete-item';
        el.setAttribute('role', 'option');
        el.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
        el.innerHTML = `
          <span class="autocomplete-item-icon">${s.icon}</span>
          <span>${s.label}<span class="autocomplete-item-sub" style="display:block;">${s.sub}</span></span>`;
        el.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
          e.preventDefault();
          searchInput.value = s.label;
          closeAutocomplete();
        });
        el.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter') { searchInput.value = s.label; closeAutocomplete(); }
        });
        autoDropdown.appendChild(el);
      });
    }
  }

  function openAutocomplete() {
    buildDropdown(searchInput.value);
    autoDropdown.classList.add('open');
    searchInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
  }
  function closeAutocomplete() {
    autoDropdown.classList.remove('open');
    searchInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  }

  searchInput.addEventListener('focus', openAutocomplete);
  searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => buildDropdown(searchInput.value));
  searchInput.addEventListener('blur', () => setTimeout(closeAutocomplete, 150));
  searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeAutocomplete();
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      const first = autoDropdown.querySelector('.autocomplete-item');
      if (first) first.focus();
    }
  });

  // ─── Scroll Reveal ───────────────────────────────
  const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  const observer  = new IntersectionObserver(
    entries => entries.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('visible'); observer.unobserve(e.target); } }),
    { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' }
  );
  revealEls.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
</script>
</body>
</html>

    .nav-link {
      padding: 8px 14px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: color .15s, background .15s;
    }
    .nav-link:hover { color: var(--navy); background: var(--gray-50); }
    .header-cta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .btn-sm { padding: 8px 18px; font-size: 14px; }

    /* Hamburger */
    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      padding: 8px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }
    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      width: 22px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all .25s;
    }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; transform: scaleX(0); }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }

    /* Mobile drawer */
    .mobile-drawer {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 200;
    }
    .drawer-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,.45);
      animation: fadeIn .2s ease;
    }
    .drawer-panel {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      right: 0;
      width: min(320px, 88vw);
      height: 100%;
      background: white;
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      animation: slideDown .25s ease;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
    }
    .drawer-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .drawer-close {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-50);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }
    .drawer-link {
      display: block;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--navy-dark);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: background .15s;
    }
    .drawer-link:hover { background: var(--gray-50); }
    .drawer-divider { height: 1px; background: var(--gray-100); margin: 8px 0; }
    .drawer-actions { margin-top: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .drawer-btn { width: 100%; text-align: center; padding: 14px; }
    .mobile-drawer.open { display: block; }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       HERO
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 580px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-dark) 0%, var(--navy) 50%, #2d1b8f 100%);
    }
    .hero-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    /* Geometric blobs */
    .hero-blob {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(60px);
      opacity: .18;
    }
    .hero-blob-1 {
      width: 500px; height: 500px;
      background: var(--yellow);
      top: -120px; right: -80px;
    }
    .hero-blob-2 {
      width: 350px; height: 350px;
      background: #7c3aed;
      bottom: -80px; left: 10%;
    }
    .hero-blob-3 {
      width: 200px; height: 200px;
      background: var(--teal);
      top: 30%; right: 25%;
    }
    /* Dot grid */
    .hero-dots {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,.12) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 28px 28px;
    }

    .hero-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      padding: 80px 0 48px;
      text-align: center;
      width: 100%;
    }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(255,217,48,.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,217,48,.35);
      color: var(--yellow);
      border-radius: 100px;
      padding: 6px 16px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .hero-badge-dot {
      width: 6px; height: 6px;
      background: var(--yellow);
      border-radius: 50%;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero-badge-dot::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: -3px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--yellow);
      animation: pulse-ring 1.5s ease-out infinite;
    }
    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5.5vw, 62px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      letter-spacing: -.03em;
      line-height: 1.1;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .hero-title-accent {
      color: var(--yellow);
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: clamp(15px, 2vw, 18px);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.75);
      line-height: 1.65;
      max-width: 580px;
      margin: 0 auto 40px;
    }

    /* ─── Search Card ─── */
    .search-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 8px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      max-width: 860px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      gap: 0;
      align-items: stretch;
      animation: scaleIn .6s .4s ease both;
    }
    .search-field {
      flex: 1;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }
    .search-field:last-of-type { border-right: none; }
    .search-field-icon {
      position: absolute;
      left: 16px;
      color: var(--navy);
      pointer-events: none;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .search-field-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
    .search-input, .search-select {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 16px 16px 16px 44px;
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text);
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      outline: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    }
    .search-input::placeholder, .search-select option[disabled] { color: var(--text-muted); }
    .search-select { appearance: none; cursor: pointer; }
    .search-select-arrow {
      position: absolute;
      right: 14px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .search-btn {
      padding: 14px 28px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      transition: background .2s, transform .2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .search-btn:hover { background: var(--navy-light); transform: scale(1.02); }
    .search-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

    /* Autocomplete dropdown */
    .autocomplete-dropdown {
      display: none;
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 8px);
      left: -8px;
      right: -8px;
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      overflow: hidden;
      z-index: 50;
      animation: slideDown .15s ease;
    }
    .autocomplete-dropdown.open { display: block; }
    .autocomplete-section-label {
      padding: 10px 16px 6px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }
    .autocomplete-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 10px 16px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background .12s;
    }
    .autocomplete-item:hover, .autocomplete-item.selected { background: var(--gray-50); }
    .autocomplete-item-icon {
      width: 32px; height: 32px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--gray-50);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      font-size: 16px;
    }
    .autocomplete-item-sub {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-weight: 400;
    }

    /* Trust row */
    .hero-trust {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 24px;
      margin-top: 28px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .hero-trust-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.7);
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .hero-trust-item svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--yellow); }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       STATS BAR
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .stats-bar {
      background: var(--off-white);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }
    .stats-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: stretch;
      justify-content: space-around;
      padding: 32px 0;
    }
    .stat-item {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0 24px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .stat-item + .stat-item::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: 10%;
      height: 80%;
      width: 1px;
      background: var(--gray-100);
    }
    .stat-number {
      font-size: clamp(26px, 3.5vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy-dark);
      letter-spacing: -.03em;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .stat-number span { color: var(--navy); }
    .stat-label {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    .stat-icon {
      width: 36px; height: 36px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: rgba(27,20,100,.08);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 10px;
    }
    .stat-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--navy); }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       SPECIALTIES
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .specialties { background: white; }
    .specialties-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 52px;
    }
    .specialties-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .specialty-card {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 28px 16px;
      background: white;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-100);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all .2s ease;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .specialty-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(27,20,100,.04), transparent);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity .2s;
    }
    .specialty-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--navy);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }
    .specialty-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
    .specialty-icon {
      width: 60px; height: 60px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 28px;
      transition: transform .2s;
    }
    .specialty-card:hover .specialty-icon { transform: scale(1.1); }
    .specialty-name {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy-dark);
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .specialty-desc {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .specialty-arrow {
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: white;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(4px);
      transition: all .2s;
    }
    .specialty-arrow svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
    .specialty-card:hover .specialty-arrow { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

    /* Icon color themes */
    .ic-blue   { background: rgba(14,165,233,.12); }
    .ic-emerald{ background: rgba(16,185,129,.12); }
    .ic-rose   { background: rgba(244,63,94,.12); }
    .ic-violet { background: rgba(139,92,246,.12); }
    .ic-amber  { background: rgba(245,158,11,.12); }
    .ic-navy   { background: rgba(27,20,100,.08); }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       HOW IT WORKS
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .how-it-works { background: var(--off-white); }
    .hiw-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 60px;
    }
    .hiw-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      position: relative;
    }
    /* Connector line */
    .hiw-steps::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 44px;
      left: calc(50% / 3);
      right: calc(50% / 3);
      height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--navy) 0%, var(--yellow) 100%);
      border-radius: 2px;
    }
    .hiw-step {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 36px 28px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: box-shadow .2s, transform .2s;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hiw-step:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-4px); }
    .hiw-step-num {
      width: 52px; height: 52px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: white;
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hiw-step:nth-child(2) .hiw-step-num { background: var(--teal); }
    .hiw-step:nth-child(3) .hiw-step-num { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy), var(--teal)); }
    .hiw-step-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: -8px;
      right: -8px;
      background: var(--yellow);
      width: 20px; height: 20px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid white;
    }
    .hiw-step-title {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy-dark);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      letter-spacing: -.01em;
    }
    .hiw-step-desc {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.65;
    }
    .hiw-step-icon { margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 32px; }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       TESTIMONIALS
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .testimonials { background: white; }
    .testimonials-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 52px;
    }
    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .testimonial-card {
      background: var(--off-white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: box-shadow .2s, transform .2s;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .testimonial-card::before {
      content: '"';
      position: absolute;
      top: -8px;
      left: 24px;
      font-size: 120px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy);
      opacity: .05;
      line-height: 1;
      font-family: Georgia, serif;
    }
    .testimonial-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-4px); }
    .testimonial-stars {
      display: flex;
      gap: 3px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .star { color: var(--yellow); font-size: 16px; }
    .testimonial-text {
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      font-style: italic;
    }
    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .av-purple { background: rgba(139,92,246,.15); color: #7c3aed; }
    .av-blue   { background: rgba(14,165,233,.15); color: #0284c7; }
    .av-teal   { background: rgba(16,185,129,.15); color: #059669; }
    .testimonial-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; color: var(--navy-dark); }
    .testimonial-loc  { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px; }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       APP PROMO
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .app-promo {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-dark), var(--navy-light));
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }
    .app-promo-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,.06) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 24px 24px;
    }
    .app-promo-inner {
      position: relative;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 60px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .app-promo-text { }
    .app-promo-label { color: var(--yellow); border-color: rgba(255,217,48,.3); background: rgba(255,217,48,.12); margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .app-promo-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      letter-spacing: -.03em;
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .app-promo-subtitle {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.72);
      line-height: 1.65;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .app-promo-features {
      margin-bottom: 36px;
    }
    .app-feature {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 8px 0;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.85);
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .app-feature-icon {
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: rgba(255,217,48,.15);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 14px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .app-buttons { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .app-promo-visual {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: flex-end;
      position: relative;
      height: 380px;
    }
    /* Phone mockup */
    .phone-mockup {
      width: 200px;
      height: 360px;
      background: white;
      border-radius: 32px;
      box-shadow: 0 32px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
      padding: 12px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      animation: float 4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .phone-screen {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--off-white);
      border-radius: 22px;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    .phone-status { height: 28px; background: var(--navy-dark); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
    .phone-notch { width: 70px; height: 10px; background: black; border-radius: 6px; }
    .phone-content { padding: 12px 10px; flex: 1; }
    .phone-header-bar { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy-dark); margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .phone-search-bar {
      background: white;
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 8px 10px;
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .phone-mini-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .phone-mini-avatar {
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(27,20,100,.1);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    .phone-mini-info { }
    .phone-mini-name { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy-dark); }
    .phone-mini-spec { font-size: 8px; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .phone-mini-btn {
      margin-left: auto;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: white;
      font-size: 7px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }
    .phone-shadow {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -20px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 160px;
      height: 40px;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,.3);
      filter: blur(20px);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    /* Second phone offset */
    .phone-mockup-2 {
      position: absolute;
      right: 20px;
      bottom: 20px;
      width: 160px;
      height: 290px;
      opacity: .55;
      z-index: 1;
      animation: float 4s 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       FOOTER
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .footer {
      background: var(--navy-dark);
      padding: 60px 0 0;
    }
    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 40px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .footer-brand .logo { color: white; margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .footer-brand-desc {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.55);
      line-height: 1.7;
      max-width: 260px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .footer-tagline {

      background: rgba(255,217,48,.12);
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,217,48,.25);
    }
    .footer-col-title {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.45);
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }
    .footer-links { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .footer-link {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.65);
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: color .15s;
    }
    .footer-link:hover { color: white; }
    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      padding: 20px 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .footer-copy {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.4);
    }
    .footer-copy strong { color: var(--yellow); }
    .footer-legal { display: flex; gap: 20px; }
    .footer-legal a {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.4);
      transition: color .15s;
    }
    .footer-legal a:hover { color: white; }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       SCROLL REVEAL
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(20px);
      transition: opacity .6s ease, transform .6s ease;
    }
    .reveal.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
    .reveal-delay-1 { transition-delay: .1s; }
    .reveal-delay-2 { transition-delay: .2s; }
    .reveal-delay-3 { transition-delay: .3s; }
    .reveal-delay-4 { transition-delay: .4s; }
    .reveal-delay-5 { transition-delay: .5s; }
    .reveal-delay-6 { transition-delay: .6s; }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       RESPONSIVE
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .specialties-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: span 2; }
      .hiw-steps::before { display: none; }
      .app-promo-inner { gap: 40px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .section { padding: 60px 0; }
      .nav, .header-cta { display: none; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }

      .search-card {
        flex-direction: column;
        border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
        gap: 2px;
        padding: 6px;
      }
      .search-field {
        border-right: none;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      }
      .search-field:last-of-type { border-bottom: none; }
      .search-btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; margin-top: 4px; }

      .specialties-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .hiw-steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .testimonials-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .app-promo-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .app-promo-visual { display: none; }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: span 2; }
      .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
      .stats-inner { flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; }
      .stat-item + .stat-item::before { display: none; }

      .hero-title { font-size: 32px; }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {

      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: span 1; }

<script>
  // ─── Hamburger / Mobile Drawer ───────────────────
  const hamburger   = document.getElementById('hamburgerBtn');
  const drawer      = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
  const overlay     = document.getElementById('drawerOverlay');
  const drawerClose = document.getElementById('drawerClose');

  function openDrawer() {
    drawer.classList.add('open');
    hamburger.classList.add('open');
    hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }
  function closeDrawer() {
    drawer.classList.remove('open');
    hamburger.classList.remove('open');
    hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
    drawer.classList.contains('open') ? closeDrawer() : openDrawer();
  });
  overlay.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  drawerClose.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeDrawer(); });

  // ─── Search Autocomplete ─────────────────────────
  const searchInput  = document.getElementById('searchInput');
  const autoDropdown = document.getElementById('autocompleteDropdown');
  const autoItems    = autoDropdown.querySelectorAll('.autocomplete-item');

  const allSuggestions = [
    { icon: '🏥', label: 'Primary Care',        sub: 'Annual checkups, sick visits' },
    { icon: '🦷', label: 'Dentist',              sub: 'Cleanings, fillings, oral health' },
    { icon: '🔬', label: 'Dermatologist',        sub: 'Skin conditions, acne, cosmetic' },
    { icon: '🧠', label: 'Psychiatrist',         sub: 'Mental health, medication management' },
    { icon: '👁️', label: 'Eye Doctor',           sub: 'Vision exams, glasses prescriptions' },
    { icon: '🦴', label: 'Orthopedic Surgeon',   sub: 'Joint pain, fractures, sports injuries' },
    { icon: '👩‍⚕️', label: 'Dr. Sarah Chen',    sub: 'Family Medicine · 4.9★' },
    { icon: '👨‍⚕️', label: 'Dr. Marcus Webb',   sub: 'Orthopedic Surgeon · 4.8★' },
    { icon: '💊', label: 'Back pain',            sub: 'Condition' },
    { icon: '💊', label: 'Anxiety',              sub: 'Condition' },
    { icon: '💊', label: 'Diabetes',             sub: 'Condition' },
  ];

  function buildDropdown(query) {
    const q = query.toLowerCase().trim();
    autoDropdown.innerHTML = '';
    const filtered = q
      ? allSuggestions.filter(s => s.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) || s.sub.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      : allSuggestions.slice(0, 5);

    if (!filtered.length) {
      autoDropdown.innerHTML = '<div class="autocomplete-item" style="color:var(--text-muted);">No results found</div>';
    } else {
      filtered.forEach(s => {
        const el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = 'autocomplete-item';
        el.setAttribute('role', 'option');
        el.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
        el.innerHTML = `
          <span class="autocomplete-item-icon">${s.icon}</span>
          <span>${s.label}<span class="autocomplete-item-sub" style="display:block;">${s.sub}</span></span>`;
        el.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
          e.preventDefault();
          searchInput.value = s.label;
          closeAutocomplete();
        });
        el.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter') { searchInput.value = s.label; closeAutocomplete(); }
        });
        autoDropdown.appendChild(el);
      });
    }
  }

  function openAutocomplete() {
    buildDropdown(searchInput.value);
    autoDropdown.classList.add('open');
    searchInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
  }
  function closeAutocomplete() {
    autoDropdown.classList.remove('open');
    searchInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  }

  searchInput.addEventListener('focus', openAutocomplete);
  searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => buildDropdown(searchInput.value));
  searchInput.addEventListener('blur', () => setTimeout(closeAutocomplete, 150));
  searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeAutocomplete();
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      const first = autoDropdown.querySelector('.autocomplete-item');
      if (first) first.focus();
    }
  });

  // ─── Scroll Reveal ───────────────────────────────
  const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  const observer  = new IntersectionObserver(
    entries => entries.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('visible'); observer.unobserve(e.target); } }),
    { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' }
  );
  revealEls.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
</script>
</body>
</html>
